413-539-1462-3821-4679.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
413-539-1462-3821-4679.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat

2961-6553-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1445-4871-7422-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7422-8095.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4559-5147-6441-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4559-5147-6441-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1479-5478-5700-5701-7892.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7892.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7892.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2335-2433-4702.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Barrenton Medic.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5570-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
5570-6797-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

893-1558-4840-5795.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
893-1558-4840-5795.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4772-5220-6961-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4772-5220-6961-7422.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

141-413-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
141-413-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 7.

2084-5726.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {3} to select its second mode, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

369-2730-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2438-2781-4681.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-2741-3399-4399.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Essence Warden triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

4222-5251-5268.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

2854-4211-4316-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4211-4316-4574.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1062-4444-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-4444-5674-5870.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

141-5748-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-5748-6798.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Umbral Collar Zealot.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

678-4826-5147-6644.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

455-1636-6406.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Hoverguard Sweepers between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
455-1636-6406.description:
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Hoverguard Sweepers trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
455-1636-6406.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

3129-4444-5742-5743.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1242-1323-3143-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Tidewater Minion each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-3143-4644.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Tidewater Minion's second ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

2440-2703-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2440-2703-4068.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

1651-2557-2797-4659.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

2143-4871.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawns die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

413-1283-1496-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
413-1283-1496-4078-4242.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

147-1777-2438-4558.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature with mana value 3 or greater.
147-1777-2438-4558.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or greater.
Extus triggers, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Burnt Offering.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Burnt Offering copy, adding at least {B/R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
If the sacrificed creature had mana value 4 or greater, this combo nets infinite black and red mana.

1283-1999-2397-4404.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1999-2397-4404.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {1}, tapping it and returning Corridor Monitor to your hand, putting Corridor Monitor from your hand onto the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {1}, tapping it and returning Chromatic Orrery to your hand, putting Chromatic Orrery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the remaining Corridor Monitor trigger from step 3, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

575-1487-4489.description:
Cast Chimeric Mass for {X} = 0.
Activate Chimeric Mass for {1}, causing it to become a 0/0 Construct creature token.
Chimeric Mass dies to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Tap that Forest for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Chimeric Mass, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

273-2459-4763-5147.description:
Equip Rograkh with Shuko.
Sacrifice Rograkh to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Rograkh to you hand.
Cast Rograkh.
Repeat.

1283-1987-2427-4125.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

1377-2123-2292-3211-3260-4078.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 23.
Your devotion to black is at least ten or you have at least two opponents.
1377-2123-2292-3211-3260-4078.description:
Cast Buried Alive by paying {2} and two life, searching for Chainer, Viscera Seer, and Kokusho.
Cast Reanimate by paying 2 life.
returning Chainer onto the battlefield and causing you to lose five life.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kokusho.
Kokusho dies, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Resolve the Viscera Seer, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 5.
